_comment: Which skill owns which trigger moment. Descriptions are the only text a host
reads when choosing a skill, so an overlap here is not a wording preference —
it decides which skill a user's sentence reaches.
Ownership is over PHRASES, not words. The words that collide (supervisor,
feedback, review, idea) are exactly the ones several skills legitimately need;
owning them would fight honest prose and be switched off by the next reader.
What can be owned is a moment: 'is it ready for the supervisor' belongs to one
skill even though four may say 'supervisor'.
Seeded 2026-08-10 from the collisions measured in docs/skill-routing.md and the
haiku probe that routed a review request to proposal-check. Moving a boundary
means editing this file in the same commit as the description.
